questions.prompt: How will you use this key?
questions.help: You can add delegated keys under a root later.

options.label: As a root
options.description: ritueel certifies other keys with it and lists it in the root list. It becomes globex/B.

options.label: As a delegated key
options.description: A root certifies it for a requester.

questions.prompt: Keep the alias of the key?
questions.help: The operator's own code may own the key and its policy. ritueel never changes either.
